answer: PwC performed limited assurance on BMW Group's 2025 Group Sustainability Report—Principles and general disclosures, Environmental, Social, Governance and Other ESG information—while disclosures specifically footnoted ‘Assurance Level: reasonable assurance’ received reasonable assurance. Those marked disclosures cover the 2030 CO2e target and Scope 1+2/Scope 3 reduction paths; own-operation and supply-chain emissions per vehicle; world, EU, USA and China fleet emissions; year-end employee breakdowns; management gender distribution; turnover; energy per vehicle and at locations; and training spending. The Foreword marked ‘Not part of ESRS reporting’ was excluded. Under ISAE 3000 (Revised), the limited conclusion was negative-form—nothing came to attention indicating material non-compliance with the applicable CSRD, ESRS/materiality-process and EU Taxonomy Article 8 requirements—whereas the marked disclosures received a positive reasonable-assurance opinion that they were prepared in all material respects under applicable criteria. Limited procedures are less extensive and yield substantially lower assurance; reasonable work extends them through greater testing, selected control operating-effectiveness tests and sample tests of details.
